ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel values with approximately 5-8% distribution of high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel clusters and streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation field across both lobes. High-contrast white markings including vertical linear streaks on the right lobe and scattered circular clusters (rosettes) distributed primarily along the lower-medial and distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing boundary, characterized by irregular jagged peaks (3-10 pixel amplitude) and valleys, most pronounced at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with initial posterior convexity transitioning to distal concavity leading toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small circular high-contrast pixel clusters consistent with barnacle attachment scars, visible on the interior of the right lobe and center.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned high-intensity linear marks; one prominent vertical streak on the right lobe and multiple smaller diagonal scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable textural irregularities and calcified protrusions at the distal tips of both lobes, suggesting heavy barnacle colonization or parasitic scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced cluster of white-grey textural anomalies at the extreme points of the fluke tips, contrasting sharply against the dark perimeter.
